full_prompt_en: A square, richly patterned oil portrait shows a young woman in left profile, leaning her chin on one hand before an ornate brown interior wall. The background is nearly flat in depth but densely worked, with rectangular panels, worn gold lines and small floral or carved motifs. Warm umber and muted olive run through it, leaving the pale face clearly separated from the intricate surface. The woman occupies most of the frame from her covered hair to the cropped lower arms. A deep red headscarf wraps around the crown and trails behind her shoulder, its folds filled with dark maroon, rust and tiny gold patterned marks. Brown curls show at the forehead and beside the ear. Her face turns toward the left edge, with a straight nose, softly parted rose lips and a calm, distant gaze. One hand supports the cheek and jaw; the sleeve at that wrist ends in a narrow pale ruffle. A cream blouse with a soft neckline appears beneath a dark green trim and a red patterned outer garment. Fine ornament covers the sleeves and bodice, but the cloth folds remain broad enough to give the torso weight. Near the lower-left edge, a red and golden apple rests on the surface before her, its rounded bright skin contrasting with the dry surrounding textile. Warm light comes from the upper left and front, spreading gently across the cheek, neck and hand. The headscarf and patterned wall stay deeper and flatter in tone, while small gold marks catch scattered highlights. The painting blends the face smoothly and lets finer linear and speckled marks describe fabric and background decoration. There are no hard cast shadows; contrast comes from pale skin against warm dark ornament. The overall composition balances a quiet profile and single rounded fruit with dense red-brown textile patterns, creating a contemplative, jewel-toned interior image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、纹样丰富的油画肖像描绘一位年轻女子朝左侧面，在华丽褐色室内墙前用一只手托住下巴。背景纵深极浅，却密集刻画了矩形分格、磨旧金线与细小花卉或雕刻纹。暖赭褐和低饱和橄榄色贯穿其间，使浅色面孔从复杂表面清楚分离。女子从包住头发的头巾到被截断的下方手臂占满画面大部分。深红头巾绕过头顶并垂在肩后，褶面充满暗栗红、锈红和金色细纹。褐色卷发露在额头与耳旁。她的脸转向左边缘，鼻梁挺直，玫瑰色嘴唇微张，目光平静而遥远。一只手托住脸颊与下颌；手腕处袖子收在一圈狭窄浅色褶边。奶油色衬衣和柔和领口显在深绿滚边及红色纹样外衣之内。细纹饰覆盖袖子与上身，布褶却仍足够宽大，给予躯干重量。靠近左下边缘，一只红金色苹果放在身前台面上，圆亮表皮对照周围干涩织物。暖光从左上与正前方到来，轻轻铺过面颊、颈部和手。头巾与花纹墙面保持更深、更平的色调，少量金色细纹接住零散高光。绘画平滑融合面孔，让更细的线性与斑点笔痕描出衣料及背景装饰。没有硬投影；反差来自浅色皮肤与暖暗花纹的对置。整体构图用安静侧影和一只圆果平衡浓密红褐织物图案，形成沉思而珠宝色般的室内图像。
style_prompt_en: The image has a richly ornamented oil-painted surface, joining smooth pale modeling to dense dry patterned marks. Warm umber, wine red, muted olive and worn gold fill most of the frame, while small cream and rose areas create the focal contrast. Fine repeated motifs and narrow seams cover broad flat regions, but larger folds preserve readable volume. Edges around lit planes are soft and carefully blended; surrounding details are more linear, speckled and tactile. A warm upper frontal light lifts exposed forms gently without strong cast shadows, and scattered gold accents catch smaller glints. The space is shallow and enclosed, with layered textiles and panels creating visual depth through texture. The overall effect is contemplative and jewel toned, balancing a clear quiet center against abundant warm decoration.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有装饰丰富的油画表面，平滑浅色塑形与密集干涩的纹样笔痕相连。暖赭褐、酒红、低饱和橄榄色和磨旧金色填满画面大部分，少量奶油色与玫瑰色形成焦点反差。细密重复纹饰与狭窄接缝覆盖宽阔平面区域，但更大的褶面保留可读体积。受光平面边缘柔和且细致融合，周围细节则更线性、斑点化且可触。上方偏正面的暖光温和提亮暴露形体，没有强投影；散布金色强调接住更小亮点。空间浅而围合，层叠纹面以肌理创造视觉纵深。整体效果沉思且如珠宝色般浓郁，在清楚安静的中心与充足暖色装饰间平衡。
theme_en: A woman in a richly patterned red headscarf resting her chin on her hand beside an apple
theme_zh: 一位戴繁纹红头巾的女子托腮坐着，身旁有一只苹果
name: Marie Spartali Stillman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
